title: Duralumin Wind
description:
Pilot a helicopter to complete objectives across four missions as you destroy the enemy and dodge incoming missiles.

Pay attention to your helicopter's status and make sure to pick up ammunition, health and fuel in order to stay in the fight. Accessing your map and mission objective screen will help you navigate between points on the map.

The camera can either rotate with the helicopter or stay fixed in its orientation. Movement can be swapped between either a fluid gliding feel or a more rigid feel. Their is no saving mid level, instead the game automatically unlocks the next level upon the completion of the current level and saves your progress. At any time you can pull up the game options menu and customize the difficulty level.
description_short: Pilot your helicopter to victory as your complete objectives, dodge missiles, and destroy your enemies. But don't forget to keep an eye on your fuel, ammunition, and health or you might not survive.
